definition: The map takes the whole window: the masthead and both side panes fold away. Escape, or the same control, gives the instrument back, and a page closed in full screen opens again with everything in place.
basis: Our wording of full screen, which docs/workbench.md describes: it "drops the masthead and both rails", and a reader who "closes the tab in full screen gets the instrument back rather than a chrome-less shell".
